editorial:
Imagine stepping back into 1990 when pop music was all about big hair, bright lights, and total idol worship. You get to experience the madness of The Point in Dublin, where thousands of screaming fans have gathered to see Jason Donovan. This isn't a scripted story, but a high-energy time capsule of a star at the absolute top of his game. The vibe is electric from the second he hits the stage, capturing that specific brand of late-eighties pop magic that feels both nostalgic and wildly upbeat. It is basically a giant party on screen that makes you feel like you are right there in the front row.

What really works here is the raw energy of the crowd and Jason's genuine charisma. The pacing is quick, moving from one hit song to the next without any boring parts. While the production style is very dated, that is actually part of the charm. If you love pop history or just want a feel-good show, you should definitely check this out. You can grab a digital rental on Apple TV to see it quickly, or if you are a real collector, try to find a physical copy for your shelf to keep that retro feel alive.
endingExplained: The show wraps up with a massive finale that leaves the crowd in a frenzy. After performing his biggest hits from Between The Lines, Jason gives a heartfelt thank you to the Dublin audience for their incredible support. He finishes with an upbeat number that gets everyone dancing one last time. The screen fades to black as the cheering reaches a peak, leaving you with the feeling of a perfect, high-energy pop concert coming to a close.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s and 90s pop music and concert films.
